analysis.title: GS Futures Commodities CTA - Market Update - November 16, 2026
key_insights: Goldman Sachs Futures Sales Strats published its CTA (trend-follower) positioning update for commodities on 16 Nov 2026. The text extraction contains only exhibit titles and a methodology legend, so no net length levels, percentiles or flow forecasts are available.

The exhibits cover broad commodity and sector net length, a sector breakdown, conditional market flows, simulated 1-year net length history, momentum threshold cross sections, simulated realized flows and 1-month conditional forecasts by market.
The desk states that all graphs are backtested or simulated results for illustrative purposes only, and that the material is not a research report from Global Investment Research.
risk_factors: The desk notes that simulated results may not reflect liquidity, transaction costs or other market factors, and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future results.
vol_and_positioning: CTA commodity net length is shown by market against a rolling 1-year distribution (interquartile range, median, min and max, with theoretical min and max from the desk's model). The current values are in chart images that the text does not carry.
The note includes simulated realized flows, momentum threshold cross sections and 1-month conditional flow forecasts by market. No figures are given in the text.
